name: Timeperiod Pattern
description: To represent time periods, as n-ary relation with a measurement unit and a numerical value.
scenarios: The measurement unit and the numerical value of a time period can be modeled.
competency_questions: Which is the measurement unit of a time period?, Which is the value of a time period?
